mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST decline (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During stagflation conditions (INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), declining industrial production and accelerating inflation cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of stagflation instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without trigger conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases over 6 months (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During demand surge conditions (RSAFS YoY decline and HOUST YoY increase), strengthening consumer spending and housing activity boost corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS YoY < 0 and HOUST YoY > 0 (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.
